changes.before: Konumunuz alınamadı — tarayıcınızın konum iznini kontrol edin.
changes.after: Konumunuz belirlenemedi — tarayıcınızdaki konum iznini kontrol edin.
changes.why: 'Konum alınamadı' is a calque of 'get'; Turkish apps say 'belirlenemedi' (ar: تعذّر تحديد). 'tarayıcınızdaki' is the plain locative instead of the genitive chain.
The heading above is already 'Gününüzü tamamlayın'; 'tamamlayacak' repeated the verb two lines apart. 'round out your route' = places you can add to it; no fact added.

changes.before: Mesafeler yaklaşıktır ve kuş uçuşu hesaplanmıştır.
changes.why: The passive 'hesaplanmıştır' is bureaucratic and slightly adds a method ('calculated'); source says only 'approximate, in a straight line'. Short note-line form.

changes.before: Eşleşme yok — başka bir sözcük deneyin.
changes.after: Eşleşen sonuç yok — başka bir kelime deneyin.
changes.why: 'Eşleşme yok' is terse and calques 'No matches'; Turkish search boxes say 'sonuç'. 'kelime' is the everyday word, 'sözcük' the TDK-purist register.

Footer links in this batch are noun phrases (Ulaşım, Etkinlikler, El-Ahsa hakkında); 'İletişim' is the near-universal Turkish footer label for 'Contact us'. 'Hata bildirin' stays an imperative because it names an action.

changes.before: Bu sayfa yok ya da taşınmış. Ana sayfaya ya da aşağıdaki gezilecek yerlere göz atabilirsiniz.
changes.after: Aradığınız sayfa yok ya da taşınmış. Aşağıdan ana sayfaya ya da gezilecek yerlere geçebilirsiniz.
changes.why: 'göz atmak' fits browsing content, not going to a home page; the two buttons are right below, so 'Aşağıdan … geçebilirsiniz'. 'Aradığınız sayfa' follows the ar and is how Turkish 404 pages open.

notes: Circumflex decision (stage 1) checked against TDK Yazım Kılavuzu and kept batch-wide: tarihî, dinî, resmî, hikâye, mekân carry it; nothing else does; P4 (names plain) untouched. No further circumflex word occurs in the batch.

Imperative convention kept: polite plural -in for actions and aria actions (Paylaşın, Kapatın, Kaydedin, Planlayın, Keşfedin, Aramayı kapatın, Hata bildirin); labels, headings and footer links are noun phrases. Footer 'Bize ulaşın' became the noun 'İletişim' to match.

TM-approved pairs reused verbatim and not touched: det.visitInfo, det.hoursNotice, det.hoursNotice.op, det.area, det.bestTime, det.openMaps, det.report, det.faq, CATEGORY_LABELS.nature. det.hoursNotice keeps 'teyit edin' (TM) although 'doğrulayın' is plainer; the TM pair is binding. Note {op} is followed by the separate word 'ile', so the template carries no suffix needing vowel harmony after a link.

Considered and kept: foot.l.getThere 'Ulaşım' (the standard Turkish footer label; 'Nasıl gidilir' would need a question mark); foot.l.privacy 'Politikalar ve koşullar' (literal to ar; narrowing to 'Gizlilik ve kullanım koşulları' would claim content not stated); trails.partOf 'Yer aldığı rotalar'; a11y.crumbs 'Gezinti yolu' (the standard Turkish UI term for breadcrumb); a11y.mainNav 'Ana menü'; a11y.skip 'İçeriğe geçin'; det.fromPlace and search.placeholder 'mekân' (TDK-common; search.placeholder needs a word other than 'yer' because the first item is 'Gezilecek yer').

Header row: nav.stores 'Çevrim içi mağazalar' (20 characters) is the longest label in the row of nine; it is the first candidate to measure. Fallbacks in order: 'Online mağazalar' (needs a termbase decision on the loan) or 'Mağazalar' (ar says only المتاجر, but alone it reads as physical shops). Not shortened here without measurement.
nav.dining 'Yeme içme' vs nav.dine 'Restoranlar ve kafeler': same page, deliberate header/footer length pair; 'Yeme içme' is how Turkish sites label the section.
Sentence case (P9) checked on every label and heading; brand 'Visit Al-Ahsa', 'UNESCO', 'WhatsApp', 'Google Haritalar', 'Enter' keep their capitals. Placeholders {op} and {n} untouched; ↗ → ✓ … kept.

termbase_proposals.suffix_vowel: i — gezilecek yerler; yere (common noun, no apostrophe)
termbase_proposals.source: tr-translation/memory/tm.json: published 'gezilecek yerler haritasında' (jabal-al-qarah); TDK gezilecek is a regular participle

termbase_proposals.suffix_vowel: ı — common phrase, no apostrophe: El-Ahsa mutfağında
termbase_proposals.source: derived from El-Ahsa (termbase, P2) + TDK mutfak; no Turkish attestation of a 'Hasawi' form

source_defects.defect: ar has an extra clause not in en ('من الأماكن التراثية في الأحساء إلى متاحف الأحساء'); en is the translation source, the Turkish follows en.

The suggest-bar strings are written from the viewpoint of the page being offered ('available in <this language>'); on a Turkish frame they only make sense if a Turkish counterpart of a non-Turkish page exists. Not a text defect; flagged for wiring.
ar is 'واحة الأحساء في اليونسكو' (Al-Ahsa Oasis at UNESCO) while en is only 'UNESCO World Heritage'; Turkish follows en. The label does not claim the link is about El-Ahsa.
